name: Ford - Dearborn Stamping Plant, Dearborn MI

fieldNotes.site: Dearborn Stamping Plant (DSP) is an interior building of Ford's 93-building Rouge Center campus. 2.7M sq ft on a ~35-acre footprint; stamps F-150 doors and hoods. Generic geocode (42.3083,-83.1563) lands on the Rouge central road/parking spine, not the building; building center relocated to ~42.3068,-83.1605 via satellite identification of the large single flat-roofed press structure with skylight rows and flanking rail spurs.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The Rouge Center is a fully fenced and guarded campus; the stamping plant is served by the complex's controlled gate system rather than its own street-facing gate. Z19 satellite of the SW Rouge gate (~42.3017,-83.169) shows a canopied checkpoint with guard booth and lane markings; Street View on the Rouge access road shows perimeter fence and a controlled pinch-point.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Staffed guard-booth structure with canopy visible at the Rouge gate in z19 imagery; Rouge Center has manned security gates.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Low confidence - DSP is interior to the Rouge; F-150 stampings ship internally to the Truck Plant and material arrives largely by rail. Few external truck docks visible; estimated 0-10 exterior doors on the SW/W building face.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: DSP is one of 93 buildings in the Rouge Center; Dearborn Truck Plant and Dearborn Engine Plant are adjacent on the same secured campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run directly alongside and into the DSP building (steel coil inbound); visible as dark linear features along the building's east edge in z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: No external trailer drop yard for this interior building; outbound stampings move internally to assembly. dropYard false.
fieldNotes.perimeter: Box approximates the DSP building footprint within the larger Rouge campus; the Rouge campus perimeter is far larger but the stamping plant occupies this ~35-acre sub-footprint.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Detroit/Dearborn metro industrial fabric - clearly Urban.
